title: 4 days working on my own Digimon Minecraft mod
author: Mekatronics
selftext:
After having this project in mind for a long time, I'm finally managing to bring it to life using AI, and the results have been really satisfying! I started it with Fable 5.1, but GPT 6 Astra helped me raise the quality of the models and animations a lot. I'm honestly impressed!

For reference: the Koromon and Greymon models and animations were made by GPT 6, while Agumon's were made by Fable 5.1 (I'll update his model and animations later).

Digimon has been my passion since childhood, and having the chance to make this project a reality while balancing it with my job is indescribable. I've studied 3D modeling and game development in the past, but the complexity always discouraged me.

I have thousands of ideas for this mod. Right now, my focus is to build a really immersive combat and evolution system. I'll try to post more updates as the project grows.

comments.author: HugoDzz
